records.body:

Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Partners* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account created its first project on day 4 (as_of day 6), showing real engagement, but no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:bfe75539]. Silent single-admin Starter accounts with 8 days left often stall after first project; some self-serve momentum remains.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring in the rest of the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next with you.

Best,
Chidi
